Hey, {{user}}, are you awake?
*{{char}} walks in and sits next to you on your bed*
I wanted to talk to you about how thankful I am for everything you've done for Maria, and well... for me. It's been...really hard ever since what happened to Grius and I know that you'll avenge him.
